title: Shopify Inc. (SHOP) Soars as Jim Cramer Applauds AI-Driven Business Formation
excerpt: Software platforms faced selling pressure due to concerns that generative AI tools would replace traditional software architectures. However, Shopify Inc. (N...
content_html:
Syeda Seirut Javed

Wed, August 12, 2026 at 1:44 PM CDT 4 min read

Software platforms faced selling pressure due to concerns that generative AI tools would replace traditional software architectures. However, Shopify Inc. (NASDAQ:SHOP) broke away from sector headwinds after second-quarter financial results showed AI tools driving business formation rather than displacing its e-commerce infrastructure. Because Shopify serves small and medium-sized businesses requiring turnkey checkout, payment processing, and store management, non-developer entrepreneurs are using AI platforms to launch storefronts faster, expanding Shopify's merchant base.

Jim Cramer Highlights 17% Post-Earnings Surge

On August 5, during the episode of CNBC's Mad Money, host Jim Cramer commented on the stock's rally and the broader AI software narrative, as he said:

Last month, all sorts of stocks that have been kept down by worries about AI competition finally got their groove back. That includes ones that should never have been down in the first place, like Shopify, which makes tools that help businesses grow their e-commerce operations. Sure, there are software tools, and everyone assumed all things software were in danger in a world where AI platforms can write code, but Shopify's customers are mostly small and medium-sized businesses, not big corporations that can use AI to replace their software.

Plus, Shopify pointed out that AI was leading to a boom in business formation, which is actually good for their business. Sure enough, when Shopify reported this morning, it shot the lights out, posting a magnificent top and bottom-line beat with very strong guidance for the current quarter. In response, the stock justifiably soared 17%.

Q2 Beat Driven by GMV Expansion and Net Income Growth

As per Shopify Inc.'s (NASDAQ:SHOP) second-quarter report, total revenue increased 33.6% year-over-year to $3.58 billion and exceeded the estimates by $140 million. Net income for the quarter rose to $1.50 billion, up from $906 million in the prior-year period. Gross merchandise volume reached $115.6 billion, which represented a 32% year-over-year increase, while monthly recurring revenue climbed to $221 million from $185 million in Q2 of the previous year.

Moreover, operating performance also reflected increased profitability. In the quarter, operating income reached $488 million, up from $291 million in the same quarter a year ago. Free cash flow came in at $654 million, yielding an 18% margin. Commenting on the quarterly momentum, President Harley Finkelstein noted that AI integrations are expanding operational capabilities across Shopify's merchant base.

赛达·塞鲁特·贾韦德

由于担心生成式人工智能工具将取代传统软件架构，软件平台面临销售压力。 然而，Shopify Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：SHOP）在第二季度财务业绩显示人工智能工具推动业务形成而不是取代其电子商务基础设施后摆脱了行业逆风。 由于 Shopify 为需要统包结账、支付处理和商店管理的中小型企业提供服务，因此非开发人员企业家正在使用 AI 平台更快地推出店面，从而扩大 Shopify 的商户基础。

Jim Cramer 强调盈利后增长 17%

8 月 5 日，在 CNBC 的 Mad Money 节目中，主持人吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 评论了该股的上涨和更广泛的人工智能软件叙述，他说：

上个月，各种因担心人工智能竞争而低迷的股票终于恢复了正常状态。 其中包括那些本来就不应该被关闭的公司，比如 Shopify，它生产帮助企业发展电子商务业务的工具。 当然，有软件工具，每个人都认为在人工智能平台可以编写代码的世界中，所有软件都处于危险之中，但 Shopify 的客户大多是中小型企业，而不是可以使用人工智能取代其软件的大公司。 另外，Shopify 指出人工智能正在导致企业形成的繁荣，这实际上对他们的业务有利。 果然，当 Shopify 今天早上发布财报时，它大放异彩，公布了令人惊叹的营收和净利润，并对本季度提供了非常强有力的指导。 作为回应，该股理所当然地飙升了 17%。

GMV 扩张和净利润增长推动第二季度业绩增长

根据 Shopify Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：SHOP）第二季度报告，总收入同比增长 33.6% 至 35.8 亿美元，超出预期 1.4 亿美元。 本季度净利润从去年同期的 9.06 亿美元增至 15 亿美元。 商品总销售额达到 1,156 亿美元，同比增长 32%，月度经常性收入从去年第二季度的 1.85 亿美元攀升至 2.21 亿美元。

此外，经营业绩也反映出盈利能力的提高。 本季度营业收入达到 4.88 亿美元，高于去年同期的 2.91 亿美元。 自由现金流为 6.54 亿美元，利润率为 18%。 总裁 Harley Finkelstein 在评论季度势头时指出，人工智能集成正在扩大 Shopify 商家基础的运营能力。
